title: Conceptual Data Model
description: Visual model of the Data Domains & Concepts Catalogue (DAT-DAC), arranged as a nested entity diagram: data domains as groups, conceptual data entities as items within each group. Derived from DAT-DAC rather than authored directly.

meta.description: A visual map of the organisation's key data concepts and how they relate.
purpose: Give a single-page view of the conceptual data landscape, grouped by data domain.
Provide a shared reference point for data modelling and integration discussions.
Provide an embeddable diagram for presentations, kept in sync with DAT-DAC.
